title: Physical benchmark suite hardening
objective: Encode patch, rigid-body, cantilever, Cook's membrane, and necking bar acceptance checks.

plan_assets.asset_description: Physical benchmark suite with models, meshes, references, and acceptance tolerances

implementation_steps: Implement patch test: constant strain, SVK elastic, irregular Hex8 → relative error < 1e-12
Implement rigid body test: SVK elastic, any Hex8 → force norm < 1e-12
Implement cantilever test: SVK elastic, 40x8x4 Hex8 → within 5% of EB beam theory
Implement Cook's membrane: J2 plasticity, graded Hex8 → tip displacement within 2% of de Souza Neto
Implement necking bar: J2 plasticity, Hex8 axial symmetry → load-displacement within 2% of Simo & Hughes
acceptance_criteria: Cantilever: within 5% of EB beam theory
Cook's membrane: tip displacement within 2% of de Souza Neto
Necking bar: load-displacement within 2% of Simo & Hughes (1998)
verification_commands: uv run pytest packages/mechdsl-core/tests/ -k benchmark -v -m e2e
risks: Mesh refinement may be needed for Cook's membrane and necking bar to meet tolerances
Reference values for de Souza Neto and Simo & Hughes must be carefully verified
